}

# ITA scope. The Axis Is Dead: out of Germany's faction and from under any
# German overlord.
wif_ita_leave_the_axis = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_subject = yes OVERLORD = { original_tag = GER } }
		OVERLORD = { end_puppet = PREV }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_in_faction = yes
			NOT = { is_faction_leader = yes }
		}
		leave_faction = yes
	}
}

# ITA scope. The Balkan Members.
wif_ita_balkan_members = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			NOT = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT }
			OR = {
				original_tag = ALB
				original_tag = MNT
				original_tag = CRO
				original_tag = GRE
				original_tag = SER
				original_tag = SLV
				original_tag = BOS
				original_tag = MAC
				original_tag = KOS
			}
			OR = {
				is_subject_of = ROOT
				has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > 49 }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
		ROOT = { add_to_faction = PREV }
	}
}
